name: REST API
description: HTTP-polled. Devices fetch /api/v1/device/<id>/frame on their wake cycle, POST heartbeats to /api/v1/device/<id>/status, and pair via /api/v1/device/register. No broker required; Tesserae itself is the only service involved. Slightly higher per-wake latency than MQTT (poll interval + HTTP round trip), but the new-install path is friction-free. The implementation lives in app/rest_api.py + app/state/pairing_store.py.
